subject: maths
question:
The graph shows the marks obtain by the four students in mathematics and English in four Unit Tests.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a858a78a6a27fdedb5bc61710d91ce5d25658866b42f9d4bce387af34b1ff512.png] 

 

The difference between the average marks obtain for all unit tests in both subject is:
solution:
**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of all values/No. of values

**Calculation**

The marks obtained by the four students in mathematics in four Unit Tests = 35 + 25 + 50 + 50

= 160

The marks obtained by the four students in English in four Unit Tests = 40 + 50 + 45 + 55

= 190

The average of marks in mathematics in four Unit Tests = 160/4

= 40

The average of marks in English in four Unit Tests = 190/4

= 47.5

The difference between the average marks obtained for all unit tests in both subjects = 47.5 - 40

= 7.5

**The answer is 7.5.**
